analysis.title: GS Ranganath - Share Repurchase Weekly Recap 16 Nov 2026
key_insights: GS buyback desk volumes for the week ending 13-Nov-2026 were 1.3x 2025 YTD ADTV and 1.3x 2024 YTD ADTV, skewed toward Industrials, Energy and Financials.
Execution mix was 45% open market and 55% 10b5-1, versus 33% / 67% the prior week, which the desk describes as strong discretionary demand.
The desk estimates about 94% of the S&P 500 is in an open window, rising to about 95% by the end of the week. The open period is expected to run through early or mid December.
November is historically the desk's second most active month. The desk expects the usual December taper as blackout periods and holiday liquidity constraints begin.
2026 YTD repurchase authorizations stand at $1.52T. 38 new programs totaling $12.4B were authorized in the week.
risk_factors: Blackout periods and holiday liquidity constraints in December are expected to reduce buyback activity.
vol_and_positioning: Corporate buyback execution is elevated, with 94% of the S&P 500 in an open window and 55% of desk flow through 10b5-1 plans. The desk expects the corporate bid to taper in December as blackouts and thin holiday liquidity set in.
